meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides the Radioline floating Vlyby video widget, footer app-store badges and footer; station rows never rendered during research.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on radioline.co/en. Station and podcast rows were still placeholders (the API did not answer from this network), so no card selector is claimed. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (machine out of memory/network when retried), station and podcast detail pages, the cookie dialog (none appeared).

LIVE counts on Home: vlyby-widget desktop home 3; store-badges desktop home 3; footer desktop home 1. The Vlyby widget (a floating video unit loaded from /vlyby/vlyby-player-floating.html) is identified by its readable wrapper class and the iframe src; I judged it an ad-like third-party widget [INFERRED], and it is the only default-on addition. div.ad-box is a fixed invisible element.

NOT verified: station rows, thumbnails, podcast pages, cookie dialog in an EU profile, phone layout. No Show/Blur/Hide option because the card markup (all hashed classes) was not available.
